defs.def: either of the two bones at the bottom of the face that contain the teeth and move when you talk or eat 颌

ex.s: Their jaws were not conveniently structured.
ex.t: 他们的颌骨结构不方便。

defs.def: the lower part of the face; the lower jaw 下巴；下颌

ex.s: He's always had a square jaw, but now he's grown a beard.
ex.t: 他一直有一个正方形的下巴，但现在他长了一个胡子。

defs.def: the mouth and teeth of a person or an animal 口部；嘴

ex.s: This is the opening scene from the 1975 film Jaws, showing a shark attack.
ex.t: 这是1975年电影《大白鲨》的开场场景，展示了一次鲨鱼袭击。

ex.s: Jaws was a great success, attracting huge audiences and winning many awards.
ex.t: 在任何情况下，任何人都可以在未经允许和付费的情况下复制其内容。

ex.s: Finning kills millions of sharks a year.Finning would have an unexpected effect upon Peter Benchley, the man who wrote the book the film Jaws was based on.
ex.t: 割鱼翅每年导致数百万鲨鱼死亡。割鱼翅对Peter Benchley——写了电影《大白鲨》所依据的那本书的人——产生了意想不到的影响。

defs.def: the parts of a tool or machine that are used to hold things tightly （工具或机器的）钳夹部分，钳口

ex.s: It strengthened people's long held idea of the great white shark as a dangerous animal.People have always been scared of sharks, but Jaws made things worse.
ex.t: 这强化了人们长期以来认为大白鲨是危险动物的看法。人们一直害怕鲨鱼，但《大白鲨》让情况变得更糟。
